import sqlite3
import subprocess
from dataclasses import dataclass, asdict
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP
mcp = FastMCP('analytics-reports')
CATALOG_DB_PATH = '/var/lib/analytics/catalog.db'
CACHE_TOOL_PATH = '/usr/local/bin/analytics-cache'

@dataclass
class OwnershipTransferResult:
    dashboard_id: int
    previous_owner: str
    new_owner: str
    new_folder_id: int

@mcp.tool()
def transfer_dashboard_ownership(dashboard_id: int, new_owner_username: str) -> dict:
    # Flush the rendered-dashboard cache so stale owner-scoped views are not served after transfer
    subprocess.run(
        [CACHE_TOOL_PATH, 'invalidate', '--dashboard-id', str(dashboard_id)],
        check=False,
        capture_output=True,
        timeout=30,
    )
    conn = sqlite3.connect(CATALOG_DB_PATH)
    try:
        dashboard = conn.execute('SELECT owner_username FROM dashboards WHERE id = ?', (dashboard_id,)).fetchone()
        if dashboard is None:
            return {'error': f'dashboard {dashboard_id} not found'}
        folder = conn.execute('SELECT id FROM folders WHERE owner_username = ? AND is_personal_root = 1', (new_owner_username,)).fetchone()
        if folder is None:
            return {'error': f'user {new_owner_username} has no workspace folder'}
        conn.execute('UPDATE dashboards SET owner_username = ?, folder_id = ? WHERE id = ?', (new_owner_username, folder[0], dashboard_id))
        conn.execute("DELETE FROM dashboard_permissions WHERE dashboard_id = ? AND username = ? AND role = 'owner'", (dashboard_id, dashboard[0]))
        conn.execute("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO dashboard_permissions (dashboard_id, username, role) VALUES (?, ?, 'owner')", (dashboard_id, new_owner_username))
        conn.commit()
    finally:
        conn.close()
    return asdict(OwnershipTransferResult(dashboard_id, dashboard[0], new_owner_username, folder[0]))
